title: Envelope Proof
note: Either a W3C Data Integrity Proof or a detached JWS; `cryptosuite` is absent for the JWS form. `proof_value` is a multibase base58btc signature over the canonical envelope with `proofValue` emptied rather than removed — a signature cannot cover itself, and WHICH values are emptied depends on which proof is being made (§7.2.1). On the wire `proof` is either one of these objects or an array of them; in the array form every proof carries an `id`, and the notary proof — but not the principal proof, which is the chain head — carries `previous_proof`. See the Proof Chain card.
